title: 21-Year-Old Man Caught Fleeing the Scene While Intoxicated
description:
On May 23, 2021, police responded to a report of a hit and run shortly after 3 am in La Crosse, WI. It was discovered that a 21-year-old man crashed into a tree and fled the scene while intoxicated.
